description: This file declares the interface IActiveRequests for managing active media requests within the Rialto server component. It includes method declarations for inserting, retrieving, erasing, and managing media segments associated with requests.

classes.name: IActiveRequests
classes.description: An interface class defining methods for managing active media requests, including insertion, retrieval, deletion, and segment management.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Inserts a new media request with specified media source type and maximum media bytes.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Retrieves the media source type associated with a given request ID.

methods.name: erase
methods.description: Removes a request by its request ID.

methods.name: erase
methods.description: Removes requests associated with a specific media source type.

methods.name: addSegment
methods.description: Adds a media segment to a specific request.

methods.name: getSegments
methods.description: Retrieves the list of media segments associated with a request ID.
